ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a black-and-white portrait of a person. The person is an elderly man, with a relatively bald top of the head, wearing round glasses, and dressed relatively formally, overall consistent with the common portrait features of Oswald Avery in biology history textbooks. Then reason: the stem asks which polymer the "person shown in the figure and his colleagues" proved carries genetic material on the basis of Frederick Griffith's bacterial genetic trait transfer experiment. Avery and his colleagues MacLeod and McCarty, through the pneumococcal transformation experiment, pointed out that the transforming factor was DNA, therefore the polymer carrying genetic material is DNA.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是一张黑白人物肖像，人物为年长男性，头顶较秃，戴圆形眼镜，符合生物学史教材中Oswald Avery的常见肖像。再读题干：题目问“如图所示的人物及其同事”在Frederick Griffith细菌遗传性状转移实验基础上证明了哪种多聚物携带遗传物质。将图中人物识别为Avery，并联想到Avery-MacLeod-McCarty实验证明肺炎链球菌的转化因子是DNA，因此答案写DNA。
